title: Reduction to rational singularities ascends along separable finite local extensions of normal surface singularities
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter resolve.tex (Resolution of Surfaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file resolve.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if reduction to rational singularities is possible for a two dimensional local normal Nagata domain, then it is possible for a finite injective local extension with separable fraction field extension (statement lines 2138-2144). The proof (proof lines 2146-2202) uses the nondegenerate trace pairing to produce a bounding element, reduces to a modification that is finite over a modification of the source, compares the first cohomology groups through the trace map, and bounds the remaining torsion by a chapter lemma. H3: an original comparison of cohomology through the trace with a reduction of the modification, written out in full.
